summary: Profile picker and PIN prompt (B3), two rounds. Round 1 fix-first at 1badb5f: two profiles on one account could share a colour (colour taken from a server-wide id modulo nine); lows: an invisible caret could file PIN digits out of order and spend an attempt, a 20px recovery link, dead style claims on the unlock fields, near-invisible empty PIN boxes. Round 2 lows-only at 8bff3b2: a deletion can recolour a displaced profile (the stability claim is false), select-all then type appends and can spend a PIN attempt, the password field's error border shows only when unfocused, no test that avatars outside the picker follow its colours; all sent to the builder. No change found in when or how a profile switch activates. Applied by cherry-pick without the unreviewed title page: package.json and index.css conflicts resolved to the profile changes only; profile-owned files byte-identical to the reviewed head.
